name: FND_NTF_APP_MODULE
description: Entity for managing external client application module registrations along with all their identifiers, preferences and global settings.

columns.name: APP_MODULE_ID
columns.description: Primary Key of the fnd_ntf_application_module table.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: The given name for the ApplicationModule.

columns.name: APIKEY
columns.description: Unique API Subscription Key alloted to the ApplicationModule.

columns.name: URL
columns.description: Callback URL hosted by the ApplicationModule.

columns.name: IS_ACTIVE
columns.description: Used as pause/resume or enable/disable switch. Also works like a soft delete column.

columns.name: PREFERENCE_JSON
columns.description: Structured (versioned) JSON object describing the application wide preference and defaults. The JSON schmea is enforced and maintained by the application layer.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
